name: japan-hobby-price-mcp
display_name: Japan Hobby Price MCP — TCG + Figures + Dlsite + Mandarake
description: Read-only MCP server combining Japanese hobby price data: TCG/used-price trends from suruga-ya.jp, anime figure prices from MyFigureList, plus live Apify actor links for dlsite and mandarake data. Four tools total: tcg_current_price, tcg_price_history, figure_current_price, figure_price_history.
long_description:
Consolidates four existing kensho hobby-data MCPs into one bundle. Exposes read-only tools for AI agents researching Japanese second-hand market prices: TCG cards (Pokemon etc.) from suruga-ya.jp, and anime figures from MyFigureList multi-shop aggregation. Each tool runs on local JSONL data — no network, no API key. For live dlsite/mandarake data, the server returns Apify actor links (surugaya-japan-hobby-prices, mandarake-surugaya-mcp) as documented in tool results.

Data sources: suruga-ya.jp TCG (960 observations, 2026-09-21), MyFigureList anime figures (654 observations). Both are bundled locally in the MCPB release.

tools.name: tcg_current_price
tools.description: Current used/new/list price for a Pokemon/TCG item from the Japan (Suruga-ya) dataset.

item.description: item name or URL substring (e.g. リザードン, pokemon card).

tools.name: tcg_price_history
tools.description: Price time series for a TCG item in the Japan (Suruga-ya) dataset.

tools.name: figure_current_price
tools.description: Current price snapshot for an anime figure from the Japan (MyFigureList) dataset.

name.description: figure name, series, character, or URL substring.

tools.name: figure_price_history
tools.description: Price time series for an anime figure in the Japan (MyFigureList) dataset.
